arguments.command:
cd /tmp/dev && cat > t1.py <<'PYEOF'
import sys
sys.path.insert(0, '/tmp/dev')
from harness import *

ok = True
L = lease('home', '2001:db8:1:1200::/56')
S = {'web': 'tcp'}

# --- basic lease states ---
rows = [
  icmp('a', 0, 5, 'put', 'home', 1, '0/i1', '2001:db8:1:1200::1', '2001:db8:1:1200::1', 'echo'),
  icmp('b', 0, 5, 'put', 'home', 2, '0/i2', '2001:db8:1:1200::2', '2001:db8:1:1200::9', 'echo'),
]
got, _ = run(campaign([L], S, [10], [make_capture(rows)]))
ok &= check('basic I/E', got['snapshots'][0]['leases'][0], {
  'lease': 'home', 'state': 'usable', 'conflicts': [],
  'internal': ['2001:db8:1:1200::1'], 'external': ['2001:db8:1:1200::9'],
  'unresolved': [], 'services': [{
     'id': 'web', 'internal_open': [], 'internal_closed': [], 'external_open': [],
     'external_closed': [], 'internal_only': [], 'protocol_errors': 0}]})
ok &= check('ledger', got['snapshots'][0]['ledger'], {'live': 2, 'deleted': 0, 'conflict': 0})

# self error adds neither
rows = [icmp('a', 0, 5, 'put', 'home', 1, '0/i1', '2001:db8:1:1200::1', '2001:db8:1:1200::1', 'error')]
got, _ = run(campaign([L], S, [10], [make_capture(rows)]))
ok &= check('self error', got['snapshots'][0]['leases'][0]['internal'], [])
ok &= check('self error unresolved', got['snapshots'][0]['leases'][0]['unresolved'],
            ['2001:db8:1:1200::1', '2001:db8:1:1200::2'])

# non-timeout error from other address -> E
rows = [icmp('a', 0, 5, 'put', 'home', 1, '0/i1', '2001:db8:1:1200::1', '2001:db8:1:1200::7', 'error')]
got, _ = run(campaign([L], S, [10], [make_capture(rows)]))
ok &= check('other error -> E', got['snapshots'][0]['leases'][0]['external'], ['2001:db8:1:1200::7'])

# canary self echo -> alias
rows = [icmp('a', 0, 5, 'put', 'home', 1, '0/c', '2001:db8:1:1200:e22c:bc0:ce5b:ffd',
             '2001:db8:1:1200:e22c:bc0:ce5b:ffd', 'echo'),
        icmp('b', 0, 5, 'put', 'home', 2, '0/i1', '2001:db8:1:1200::1', '2001:db8:1:1200::1', 'echo')]
got, _ = run(campaign([L], S, [10], [make_capture(rows)]))
ok &= check('alias state', got['snapshots'][0]['leases'][0]['state'], 'alias')
ok &= check('alias internal empty', got['snapshots'][0]['leases'][0]['internal'], [])
ok &= check('alias unresolved all', got['snapshots'][0]['leases'][0]['unresolved'],
            ['2001:db8:1:1200::1', '2001:db8:1:1200::2'])

# canary answered by other address -> neither
rows = [icmp('a', 0, 5, 'put', 'home', 1, '0/c', '2001:db8:1:1200:e22c:bc0:ce5b:ffd',
             '2001:db8:1:1200::5', 'echo')]
got, _ = run(campaign([L], S, [10], [make_capture(rows)]))
ok &= check('canary other', (got['snapshots'][0]['leases'][0]['state'],
                             got['snapshots'][0]['leases'][0]['internal'],
                             got['snapshots'][0]['leases'][0]['external']), ('usable', [], []))

# conflict: same responder in I and E
rows = [icmp('a', 0, 5, 'put', 'home', 1, '0/i1', '2001:db8:1:1200::1', '2001:db8:1:1200::1', 'echo'),
        icmp('b', 0, 5, 'put', 'home', 2, '0/i2', '2001:db8:1:1200::2', '2001:db8:1:1200::1', 'echo')]
got, _ = run(campaign([L], S, [10], [make_capture(rows)]))
ok &= check('conflict state', got['snapshots'][0]['leases'][0]['state'], 'conflict')
ok &= check('conflict list', got['snapshots'][0]['leases'][0]['conflicts'], ['2001:db8:1:1200::1'])
ok &= check('conflict unresolved', got['snapshots'][0]['leases'][0]['unresolved'],
            ['2001:db8:1:1200::1', '2001:db8:1:1200::2'])

# alias + conflict: alias wins state but conflicts still reported
rows = [icmp('a', 0, 5, 'put', 'home', 1, '0/c', '2001:db8:1:1200:e22c:bc0:ce5b:ffd',
             '2001:db8:1:1200:e22c:bc0:ce5b:ffd', 'echo'),
        icmp('b', 0, 5, 'put', 'home', 2, '0/i1', '2001:db8:1:1200::1', '2001:db8:1:1200::1', 'echo'),
        icmp('c', 0, 5, 'put', 'home', 3, '0/i2', '2001:db8:1:1200::2', '2001:db8:1:1200::1', 'echo')]
got, _ = run(campaign([L], S, [10], [make_capture(rows)]))
ok &= check('alias beats conflict', got['snapshots'][0]['leases'][0]['state'], 'alias')
ok &= check('alias still reports conflicts', got['snapshots'][0]['leases'][0]['conflicts'],
            ['2001:db8:1:1200::1'])

# inactive lease
got, _ = run(campaign([lease('home', '2001:db8:1:1200::/56', 0, 5)], S, [10],
                      [make_capture([icmp('a', 0, 4, 'put', 'home', 1, '0/i1',
                                          '2001:db8:1:1200::1', '2001:db8:1:1200::1', 'echo')])]))
ok &= check('inactive', got['snapshots'][0]['leases'][0],
            {'lease': 'home', 'state': 'inactive', 'conflicts': [], 'internal': [],
             'external': [], 'unresolved': [],
             'services': [{'id': 'web', 'internal_open': [], 'internal_closed': [],
                           'external_open': [], 'external_closed': [], 'internal_only': [],
                           'protocol_errors': 0}]})
ok &= check('inactive ledger live', got['snapshots'][0]['ledger']['live'], 1)
print('ALL OK' if ok else 'FAILURES')
PYEOF
python3 t1.py
